<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="center"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><a name="FIS_PART_I"><!--EFPlaceholder--></a>PART I</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><!--EFPlaceholder--><a name="Business">ITEM 1:&#160;BUSINESS</a></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Corporate Information</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The Company was founded as WorldWide Product Distribution,&#160;Inc. (&#8220;Worldwide&#8221;) in 1988.&#160;&#160;OMP Acquisition Corporation was incorporated in&#160;California in October 1997 to purchase substantially all of the assets and to assume the accounts payable and related operating liabilities of WorldWide and subsequently changed its name to Obagi Medical Products,&#160;Inc. in December 1997.&#160;&#160;OMP,&#160;Inc. (&#8220;OMP&#8221;) was incorporated in Delaware in November 2000; in January 2001 Obagi Medical Products,&#160;Inc. was merged into OMP, with OMP as the surviving corporation.&#160;&#160;In December 2004, the stockholders of OMP exchanged their shares of OMP for an equal number of shares in a newly formed holding company incorporated in Delaware, Obagi Medical Products,&#160;Inc., which became the parent holding company for all existing operations of OMP.&#160;&#160;Unless the context indicates otherwise, in this Report we use the terms &#8220;Obagi,&#8221; &#8220;we,&#8221; &#8220;us&#8221; and &#8220;our&#8221; to refer to Obagi Medical Products,&#160;Inc. and its subsidiaries on a consolidated basis.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Our principal executive offices are located at 3760 Kilroy Airport Way, Suite 500, Long Beach, California 90806, and our telephone number at that location is (562)&#160;628-1007.&#160;&#160;Our website address is <font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline">www.obagi.com</font>.&#160;&#160;Copies of our most recent Annual Report on Form&#160;10-K, Quarterly Reports on Form&#160;10-Q, Current Reports on Form 8-K and other filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission (&#8220;SEC&#8221;) can be obtained free of charge as soon as reasonably practicable after such materials are electronically filed with, or furnished to, the SEC by clicking the SEC Filings link from the Investor Relations page on our website at <font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline">www.obagi.com.</font> &#160;Members of the public may also read and copy any materials we file with, or furnish to, the SEC at the SEC&#8217;s Public Reference Room at 100 F Street, NE, Washington, DC 20549.&#160;&#160;To obtain information on the operation of the Public Reference Room, please call the SEC at 1-800-SEC-0330.&#160;&#160;The SEC also maintains an Internet site at <font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline">www.sec.gov</font> that contains the reports, proxy and information statements, and other information that we file electronically with the SEC.&#160;&#160;Our website and the information contained thereon or connected thereto are not intended to be incorporated into this Report.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Our common stock trades on the Nasdaq Global Market under the symbol &#8220;OMPI.&#8221;</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Overview</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We are a specialty pharmaceutical company that develops, markets and sells, and are a leading provider of, proprietary topical aesthetic and therapeutic prescription-strength skin care systems and related products in the physician-dispensed market.&#160;&#160;Obagi systems and products are designed to prevent and improve the most common and visible skin disorders in adult skin, including premature aging, photodamage, hyperpigmentation (irregular or patchy discoloration of the skin), acne, sun damage, facial redness, and soft tissue deficits, such as fine lines and wrinkles.&#160;&#160;Our products have been developed to enhance the underlying health of patients&#8217; skin, and clinical studies have demonstrated that the use of our systems results in skin that looks and acts younger and healthier.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We sell our products through a direct sales force in the United States and internationally through distribution partners in over 43 countries across North America, Central America, Europe, the Middle East and Asia.&#160;&#160;Our domestic</font></div>

<div align="left"><br>
</div>

<div align="left">
<div id="PGBRK" style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; WIDTH: 100%; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">
<div id="FTR">
<div id="GLFTR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</div>

<div id="PN" style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; WIDTH: 100%">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">2</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%">
<hr style="COLOR: black" noshade size="2">
</div>
</div>

<div id="HDR">
<div id="GLHDR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="right"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&#160;</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">sales force and foreign distributors predominantly sell our products directly to dermatologists, plastic surgeons and other physicians who are focused on aesthetic and therapeutic skin care.&#160;&#160;These physicians then dispense our products in-office, directly to their patients.&#160;&#160;We believe that we are the market leader in this growing physician-dispensed skin care channel, according to a 2011 study by Kline&#160;&amp;&#160;Co., an independent market research firm.&#160;&#160;Our net sales have grown from approximately $35.6&#160;million in 2001 to $114.1&#160;million for the year ended December 31, 2011.&#160;</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Over the years, we have developed numerous skin care products and systems for the enhancement of skin health.&#160;&#160;Using our Penetrating Therapeutics technologies, our products are designed to improve the penetration of prescription and over-the-counter (&#8220;OTC&#8221;) cosmetic agents across the skin barrier to address the most common and visible skin conditions in adult skin.&#160;&#160;Our product portfolio, which includes cosmetic OTC and prescription products, including 4% hydroquinone, is sold and promoted through physician offices and requires education by a physician on proper use.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Our leading product line, launched in 1988, is the Obagi Nu-Derm System.&#160;&#160;We believe the Nu-Derm System is the&#160;leading clinically-proven, prescription-based topical skin health system on the market that has been shown to enhance the skin&#8217;s overall health by correcting photodamage using drugs that, by definition, work at the cellular level.&#160;&#160;This results in a reduction of the visible signs of aging.&#160;&#160;In addition, we offer several other skin care systems and related products, including: (i) the Obagi-C Rx System, introduced in 2004, a prescription-strength system that reduces the early effects of sun damage and evens skin tone through the use of a Vitamin C serum combined with 4% hydroquinone; (ii) our Professional-C series of products, introduced in 2005, which consist of high potency antioxidant Vitamin C serums that help to counteract the effects of ultraviolet radiation and other environmental influences; (iii) the Condition &amp; Enhance System, launched in 2006, which was developed to enhance the results of physician-delivered surgical and non-surgical cosmetic procedures, such as Botox, injectable fillers, chemical peels, microdermabrasion and laser resurfacing treatments; (iv) the ELASTIderm family of products, first introduced in 2006, which includes treatments developed to restore skin elasticity and collagen production, and reduce fine lines and wrinkles, around the eyes and d&#233;colletage; (v) our CLENZIderm M.D. Acne Therapeutic Systems, introduced in 2007, featuring a solubilized formulation of benzoyl peroxide (&#8220;BPO&#8221;) to treat and prevent acne at its root; (vi) the Rosaclear System, launched in 2009, which is a complete prescription-based system developed specifically for the treatment and prevention of the signs and symptoms of facial redness; (vii) ELASTILash Eyelash Solution, a member of the ELASTIderm family launched in 2010, designed to help achieve the appearance of visibly thicker, fuller-looking eyelashes; (viii) Blue Peel RADIANCE, launched in 2011, a gentle salicylic acid-based peel that utilizes a unique blend of acids and other soothing ingredients for a potent combination that exfoliates, evens out skin tone and improves overall complexion, with little-to-no downtime; and (ix) ELASTIderm Complete Complex Eye Serum, launched in January 2012, that utilizes an innovative rollerball technology for application.&#160;&#160;We also offer: (i) tretinoin, a generic equivalent to Retin-A that is among the most widely used acne treatments, as well as Refissa, a 0.05% strength tretinoin, approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration (&#8220;FDA&#8221;), with an emollient base that has a broad indication for treatment of fine facial lines, hyperpigmentation and tactile roughness; (ii) metronidazole topical gel, a generic equivalent to Metrogel, for use in conjunction with our Rosaclear System; and (iii) Obagi Blue Peel Essential Kit, which has been cited by Kline&#160;&amp;&#160;Co. as one of the most well-known brands for use in physician-strength facial peel procedures.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We also advance our development objectives through product and license agreements with third parties.&#160;&#160;These agreements may include patent and technology licenses, product licenses and new product collaboration agreements.&#160;&#160;We compete in the Japanese retail skin care markets through strategic licensing agreements with a Japanese pharmaceutical manufacturer and distributor that sell a series of OTC products under the Obagi brand name in the Japanese drug and variety store channels.&#160; In addition, through December 31, 2011 we had other licensing arrangements in Japan to market and sell OTC product systems under the Obagi brand through the aesthetic spa channel.&#160;&#160;Our net licensing revenue from skin health systems and products in Japan was approximately $4.4&#160;million for the year ended December 31, 2011.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">The Skin Care Market</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><a name="OBAGI200910K_HTM_LIST"><!--EFPlaceholder--></a>According to the American Society of Plastic Surgeons, there were 13.8 million cosmetic procedures performed in the United States in 2011, representing a 5% increase over 2010 and a 87% increase over 2000.&#160;&#160;We believe this reflects a growing desire and acceptance among the population to seek assistance from physicians to improve their appearance, including the appearance of their skin.&#160;&#160;A key driver of this trend is the aging of the &#8220;baby boomer&#8221; segment of the U.S. population.&#160;&#160;In addition, life expectancy in the United States has extended in recent years, leading to a further increase in the average age of the country&#8217;s population.&#160;&#160;Because healthcare needs, including the treatment of skin disorders, tend to increase with age, we expect the demand for&#160;skin care&#160;products to continue to increase over time.&#160;&#160;In particular, women tend to demonstrate a higher motivation than men to improve their personal appearances.&#160;&#160;The number of women between the ages of 35 and 65, the primary users of our products, was estimated by the U.S. Census Bureau to have grown 44.7% between 1990 and 2010.&#160;&#160;With this segment&#8217;s strong desire to reduce the signs of premature aging, we expect the aging female population to continue to increase the market opportunity for skin care products.</font></div>

<div align="left"><br>
</div>

<div align="left">
<div id="PGBRK" style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; WIDTH: 100%; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">
<div id="FTR">
<div id="GLFTR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">3</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%">
<hr style="COLOR: black" noshade size="2">
</div>
</div>

<div id="HDR">
<div id="GLHDR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="right"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Most of the cosmetic skin care products available today are designed to mask the effects of aging and skin disorders, rather than treat the underlying health of the skin.&#160;&#160;As a result, consumers may see temporary skin surface improvements, but underlying skin restoration often does not occur because the active agents in these products lack the ability to effectively penetrate the skin barrier.&#160;&#160;In addition, most traditional approaches to skin care are not comprehensive programs designed to integrate complementary products.&#160;&#160;Individual products, even those that are widely used by consumers (such as facial soaps or sunscreens), are not generally designed to work together, and therefore may cause unintended side effects or reduced effectiveness when used in combination.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">For these reasons, consumers have increasingly turned to their physicians for products and simple in-office procedures that can provide better results than consumer cosmetics.&#160;&#160;For example, physician-recommended cosmetic products and commonly performed cosmetic procedures such as Botox injections, injectable fillers, laser hair removal&#160;and microdermabrasion, have experienced substantial growth as consumers learn that they can achieve positive cosmetic results with minimally invasive techniques.&#160;&#160;Beyond anti-aging and aesthetic treatments, there is also significant market demand for effective products that treat skin diseases such as acne, rosacea, psoriasis, and eczema (dermatitis), as well as for eyelash enhancement and effective sunscreen products.&#160;&#160;While a number of therapies, treatments and products exist for such diseases or conditions, most treatments or products consist of either topical applications with limited efficacy, or systemic (oral) applications that carry significant potential side effects.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">According to Kline&#160;&amp;&#160;Co., in 2011, there were approximately 25,900 physicians practicing dermatology and plastic surgery in the United States, of which more than 11,800 dispensed skin care products directly to their patients.&#160;&#160;Based on our experience with physicians who have opened accounts with us, we believe a growing number of general practice, family practice, internal medicine, dental and obstetrics and gynecology (&#8220;OBGYN&#8221;) physicians are also dedicating resources in their practices to skin care.&#160;&#160;We believe that these physicians are responding to the rapid increase in consumer demand for non-invasive skin care treatments.&#160;&#160;Furthermore, according to Kline &amp; Co., more than 7,800 of these physicians dispensed prescription and non-prescription skin care products directly to their patients in 2011.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Outside of the United States, the physician-dispensed skin care market varies by country due to cultural differences and regulatory requirements.&#160;&#160;Cultural desires for skin with lighter and more even pigmentation have created large and growing aesthetic skin care demands throughout Asia, particularly Japan, China and Korea.&#160;&#160;European and certain South American countries such as Brazil also present large skin care markets due to the complementary growth in cosmetic procedures and willingness on the part of their consumers to spend discretionary income on aesthetic enhancements.&#160;&#160;We believe that the growth in major international markets will also be driven by cultural desires to lessen the appearance of skin darkening caused by exposure to sun, aging populations and a heightened awareness and availability of aesthetic products and procedures.&#160;&#160;While physician dispensing is common in most countries, certain countries prohibit or limit the types of products that can be dispensed from a physician&#8217;s office, requiring physicians to either partner with a retail pharmacy or drug store, or to simply forgo dispensing.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Our Obagi Systems and Related Products</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We believe the effects of aging and skin disorders are best addressed at a deeper level, where the skin&#8217;s natural cell regeneration processes occur, rather than at the surface of the skin.&#160;&#160;Thus, a number of our systems and related products have been designed to improve the overall health of the skin by improving cellular processes such as collagen and elastin production, keratinocyte clearing, and melanocyte regulation, using drugs that, by definition, work at the cellular level.&#160;&#160;We have developed comprehensive skin care systems and products that incorporate a range of individual prescription and non-prescription therapeutic agents, as well as cosmetic ingredients.&#160;&#160;The individual components of each system and related products have been specifically formulated to complement one another, enhancing the effectiveness of a particular system as a whole and allowing the physician to tailor the treatment program to the specific needs of the patient.&#160;&#160;The design of our systems and products is generally proprietary to us, and we are the sole licensee of both provisional and issued U.S. patents and have patent applications pending for the composition of most of these products.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Obagi Nu-Derm System</font></div>

<div align="left"><font id="TAB2" style="LETTER-SPACING: 9pt">&#160;&#160;&#160;</font>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; Our Obagi Nu-Derm System was initially launched in 1988, and since that time, we have made substantial enhancements to the system through the application of our Penetrating Therapeutics technologies.&#160;&#160;We believe that the Nu-Derm System is the&#160;leading clinically proven, prescription-based topical skin health system currently available that <br>

<div align="left"><br>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">has been shown to enhance the skin&#8217;s overall health by correcting photodamage using ingredients including pharmaceutical agents that, by definition, work at the cellular level.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The Obagi Nu-Derm System consists of a combination of six prescription, OTC therapeutic agents&#160;and adjunctive cosmetic skin care products to treat visible skin conditions such as photodamage and hyperpigmentation resulting from extrinsic damage and intrinsic changes to the skin.&#160;&#160;The Nu-Derm cosmetic skin care products include cleansers and exfoliating creams.&#160;&#160;Three of these products contain hydroquinone, in a 4% prescription concentration, which acts as a bleaching agent that is designed to correct skin pigmentation problems by normalizing the production of new melanin in the epidermis.&#160;&#160;Physicians may also prescribe the drug tretinoin as a complement to the system, in various concentrations, depending on the physician&#8217;s judgment of patient need.&#160;&#160;We believe that the use of these prescription therapeutic agents, the ability of such agents to penetrate the skin&#8217;s surface and the order of application distinguishes our Nu-Derm System from other commonly prescribed regimens.&#160;&#160;While we have designed the Nu-Derm System to include products that patients can use in a systematic treatment regimen, we also make the component products available for individual sale.&#160;&#160;We believe that physicians who dispense the Obagi Nu-Derm System generally encourage their patients to use the component products together in a systematic treatment regimen.&#160;&#160;However, we also believe that some patients elect to use the products that make up the system individually.&#160;&#160;Products that are used individually at times include the sunscreen products and Obagi Nu-Derm Clear, which physicians may dispense on occasion to address localized pigmentation problems.&#160;&#160;Side effects from use of the products may include redness, mild to moderate irritation and/or excessive flaking or sloughing of the outer layers of the treated skin.&#160;&#160;Side effects generally resolve after the first 10&#160;days of use, or in cases with certain sensitive individuals, in a few days upon discontinuance of use.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The Obagi Nu-Derm System, including the Obagi Condition &amp; Enhance System (described below), accounted for approximately 53% and 52% of our consolidated net sales for the years ended December&#160;31, 2011 and 2010, respectively.&#160;&#160;Although the volume of sales for each individual product within the system varies, we believe the majority of our sales of each component product is due to the fact that they are sold as part of the system.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Obagi Condition &amp; Enhance</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Penetrating Therapeutics</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Our product development strategy is to enhance the efficacy of established, widely prescribed, FDA-approved dermatology products (both prescription and OTC) by developing mechanisms that significantly enhance the penetration of these agents across the skin&#8217;s protective barrier into the deeper layers of the skin, where therapeutic benefits are realized.&#160;&#160;We describe this enabling technology as Penetrating Therapeutics, in which the individual chemical characteristics of both active and inactive agents are addressed and then combined in a systematic manner based on their pharmacokinetic properties.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Online Pharmacy Fulfillment</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We have identified the elements necessary to establish a web-based marketing and fulfillment operation, including the creation of a nationwide online pharmacy.&#160;&#160;We believe a robust e-Commerce platform will help build and strengthen the relationship between our physician customers and their patients.&#160;&#160;The information and leverage we will gain by being at the hub of each transaction will enable us to add value to the physicians&#8217; businesses, while making the purchase of our products significantly more convenient for end-users. Further, this platform will assist our core physician partners in maximizing the total &#8220;Obagi&#8221; opportunity by no longer being constrained in the complement of our products that they carry due to shelf limitations, and reinforce the brand&#8217;s value and its loyalty among our end users by streamlining our total distribution network.&#160;&#160;Once fully developed and deployed our new national distribution system will allow us to deploy new channel expansion strategies going forward and protect our brand from internet discounters by implementing a track and trace mechanism to follow products&#8217; pedigrees through the sales channel.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">As a result of our research, we believe that a high degree of interest in Obagi is present on the Internet, which our historical business structure cannot adequately serve.&#160;&#160;We believe that our physician-dispensed channel currently serves only a fraction of the total potential patient population.&#160;&#160;Having an e-Commerce platform will enable us to capitalize on the interest in our products by directing consumers to one place to learn about and purchase our products, capture a portion of this new business for our physician customers and serve a larger population of potential patients.&#160;&#160;However, we cannot assure you that our e-Commerce platform will actually expand our base of end-users or result in the growth of our business.&#160;&#160;Moreover, the creation and maintenance of an e-Commerce platform will require a significant <font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">investment in capital and other resources and may divert the attention of our management and other key employees from the operation of our core business, which could materially and adversely impact our business and results of operations beginning in 2012.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Sales and Marketing</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Domestic</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">In the United States, we sell our systems and related products directly to physicians through our internal sales force.&#160;&#160;Physicians then dispense our products in-office, directly to their patients, a distribution method commonly referred to as the &#8220;physician-dispensed&#8221; channel.&#160;&#160;We believe that the physician-dispensed distribution model ultimately results in higher patient satisfaction because it is better suited to the provision of system-based skin care than traditional drug distribution channels.&#160;&#160;Our physician customer base consists primarily of plastic surgeons and dermatologists, but also includes physicians from other practice areas, such as general practice, family practice, internal medicine, dental&#160;and OBGYNs who are adding skin care to their practices.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Based on a 2011 study by Kline&#160;&amp;&#160;Co., we are the leading skin health company in the physician-dispensed channel, with an estimated 30.1% market share, nearly two times the market share of the next largest competitor.&#160;&#160;As of December 31, 2011, we had approximately 6,600 active accounts in the United States.&#160;&#160;Each account has at least one licensed physician on-site and we estimate that there are over 12,500 physicians in total practicing under these active accounts.&#160;&#160;This includes physicians on-site at a small but growing number of medical spas.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The U.S. market accounted for 83% and 84% of our net sales for the years ended December&#160;31, 2011 and 2010, respectively.&#160;&#160;As of December 31, 2011, we had 141 sales, marketing and education specialists, including 106 dedicated sales representatives and managers.&#160;&#160;We believe that we have sufficient sales representation to enable us to effectively target the plastic surgeons, dermatologists and aesthetic skin care physicians who dispense skin care products in the United States.&#160;&#160;In addition to effective systems, we also offer turn-key practice building programs and patient events that help these physicians grow their practices.&#160;&#160;These resources help physicians improve their recurring patient visits and revenue streams.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Our marketing efforts have a dual focus.&#160;&#160;First, we market directly to physicians in an attempt to create treatment awareness and encourage the use of our products by both new and existing physician clients.&#160;&#160;To support this effort, we use medical journal advertising, sales aids, videos, CDs and slide demonstrations, physician-to-physician speaker presentations, trade shows, reminder items, educational and training support, internet resources, and telemarketing.&#160;&#160;Second, we attempt to create and then build upon the relationships with our physician customers by marketing our products to their patients.&#160;&#160;We accomplish this through in-office materials in our physician customers&#8217; medical practices; consumer engagement through our website, beauty blogs and social media outlets; public relations efforts to create brand awareness; and product maintenance programs to increase patient loyalty.&#160;&#160;In addition,&#160;we provide patient education booklets and videos, funding for cooperative advertising, training and direct assistance in patient seminars and other programs, continuous product education and public relations programs for patient referrals.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">In addition, our research and development staff is designing and directing clinical studies to support the application of our existing product lines for new markets and to enhance our current marketing efforts.&#160;&#160;We have conducted numerous studies with the leading academic institutions and key experts in dermatology and aesthetic medicine, and will continue to expand our collaborations with leading dermatologists and institutions to coordinate additional clinical studies for new product applications and formulations.&#160;&#160;We believe evidence from our clinical studies will validate the performance of our existing products and provide a platform for the development of new products and product applications.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">International</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">International markets accounted for 17% and 16% of our net sales for the years ended December&#160;31, 2011 and 2010, respectively.&#160;&#160;We address international markets through 18 international distribution partners that have sales and marketing activities in approximately 43 countries outside of the United States, and three trademark and know-how license agreements for the retail drug store channel in Japan.&#160;&#160;We target distribution partners who are capable and willing to mirror our sales and distribution model in the United States and who have an established business and reputation with physicians.&#160;&#160;The products that we sell internationally are generally the same formulations as those sold in the United States; however, in some instances, formulations have been modified to comply with the regulatory requirements of certain countries.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">These distributors use a model similar to our business model in the United States, addressing their territories through direct sales representatives who sell to physicians, or through alternative distribution channels, depending on regulatory requirements and industry practices.&#160;&#160;The sale of skin health and restoration products through physician offices is not as widely established internationally as it is in the United States.&#160;&#160;For example, some of our more successful international distribution partners include our partners in Europe, Southeast Asia, the Middle East and North </div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We intend to continue expanding our international presence by entering into strategic relationships in key locations such as Asia and Europe.&#160;&#160;We believe that there is potential for significant sales growth of our products in international markets due to cultural emphasis on overall skin health and appearance, and the continued development and acceptance of surgical and non-surgical cosmetic procedures throughout many countries of the world.&#160;&#160;In 2012, we intend to invest in efforts to assess international market opportunities and to review and optimize our current international markets.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Licensing</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">In areas where the physician-dispensed skin care channel is underdeveloped, we look for alternative models to build a presence and brand awareness for our products.&#160;&#160;For example, in Japan we have pursued two separate distribution channels for our brand and product concepts.&#160;&#160;In 2002, we launched our first formal long-term relationship in Japan by entering into a trademark and know-how license agreement with Rohto Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (&#8220;Rohto&#8221;) to market and sell our Obagi-developed products in Japan.&#160;&#160;Rohto is a Japanese pharmaceutical manufacturer and distributor.&#160;&#160;Under our current agreement, Rohto is licensed to manufacture and sell a series of OTC products developed by it under the Obagi brand name, as well as Obagi-C products, in the Japanese drug store channel, for which it pays us a license fee.&#160;&#160;Rohto&#8217;s Obagi branded products achieved retail annual sales of over $75.0&#160;million in 2011 through approximately 6,300 high-end drug and variety stores.&#160;&#160;In 2008, we&#160;expanded that relationship to provide for collaboration on the development of new products and to pursue the higher end department store channel in Japan.&#160;&#160;In addition, at the end of 2008 we entered into a License Distribution Agreement with Rohto for sales of products using our bi-mineral complex technology, for which we receive royalty payments on net sales.&#160;&#160; Our strategic partner in Japan has engaged in aggressive direct-to-consumer advertising, which we believe has raised consumer demand in Japan, creating greater brand awareness in the physician channel to the benefit of our core prescription lines.&#160;&#160;During the year ended December 31, 2011, our distribution channel in Japan generated approximately $4.4&#160;million in license fees.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We will continue to look for credible partners to address new geographies, and to evaluate alternative channel opportunities in Japan and other countries to drive brand awareness and accelerate overall market penetration.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Manufacturing</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We believe our manufacturing processes&#160;provide us with&#160;a competitive advantage, which we have developed through years of experience formulating skin care products.&#160;&#160;We maintain manufacturing scalability and flexibility by maintaining manufacturing with several qualified independent third-party contract manufacturers. Our main contract manufacturers during&#160;2011 included&#160;Arizona Natural Resources, Inc., Bay Cities Container Corporation,&#160;Denison Pharmaceuticals Inc., Ei, Inc., PureTek Corporation and Swiss-American Products Inc., and we continue to explore and establish relationships with additional third-party manufacturers.&#160;&#160;However, we do not have long-term contracts with most of these parties.&#160;&#160;For all of our proprietary product concepts, we believe we own the related manufacturing processes, methods and formulations.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We use FDA-compliant manufacturers who specialize in the manufacture of prescription and OTC pharmaceutical and/or cosmetic products.&#160;&#160;These parties manufacture products pursuant to our specifications.&#160;&#160;All of these manufacturers are required by law and by our manufacturing standards to comply with current Good Manufacturing Practice (&#8220;cGMP&#8221;).&#160;&#160;We pre-qualify and continually monitor our manufacturers for quality and compliance.&#160;&#160;We also require documentation of compliance and quality from those manufacturers for whom we act as representative in connection with the promotion and sale of their products.&#160;&#160;For most of our key products, we have two or more qualified manufacturers.&#160;&#160;Although certain products, including some of our sun protection products, are currently supplied by a single source, we&#160;intend to&#160;qualify additional manufacturers for such products.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Intellectual Property</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Our success depends in part on our ability to obtain and maintain proprietary protection for our product candidates, technology and know-how, to operate without infringing the proprietary rights of others and to prevent others from infringing our proprietary rights.&#160;&#160;Our policy is to seek to protect our proprietary position by, among other methods, filing United States and foreign patent applications related to our proprietary technology, inventions and improvements that are important to the development of our business.&#160;&#160;In connection with developing new products and product applications, we have filed, or have obtained an exclusive license to, 30 U.S. provisional and non-provisional patent applications since 2004.&#160;&#160;We also rely on trade secrets, know-how, continuing technological innovation and in-licensing opportunities to develop and maintain our proprietary position.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We have pursued an aggressive trademark registration policy as a means to achieve brand recognition and product differentiation in the market.&#160;&#160;We own various U.S. and foreign trademark registrations and applications and common law marks.&#160;&#160;</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We have licensed certain patent applications owned by JR Chem LLC (&#8220;JR&#8221;) covering our ELASTIderm, CLENZIderm and Rosaclear Systems.&#160;&#160;We have also relied on services provided by JR in the development of new products to address acne, skin elasticity and facial redness, under a five-year contract.&#160;&#160;Although that contract expired in September 2010, we believe the license and royalty obligations of the parties under the contract survived termination.&#160;&#160;See &#8220;Certain Material Agreements &#8211; <font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline">Jose Ramirez and JR</font>&#8221; below.&#160;&#160;In addition, we have licensed the rights to four patents owned by Avon, one of which expired in 2008 while the remaining three expire between 2013 and 2018, covering methods and formulations for stabilizing Vitamin C in a serum for facial skin benefits, which is in our Obagi-C Rx C-Clarifying serum, Professional-C 5% serum and Professional-C 10% serum.&#160;&#160;We entered into the license agreement with Avon in June 2003, for an initial three-year term, which is renewed year to year thereafter, at our option, through the life of the last patent to expire.&#160;&#160;The last patent will expire in September 2018.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We have also acquired rights to market, distribute, sell and, in some cases, make products pursuant to license agreements with other third parties.&#160;&#160;Such agreements contain provisions that require us to meet certain specified requirements, such as quantity purchase and&#160;payment obligations, in order to maintain the rights granted under the agreements.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Obagi Agreements<br>
</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><font style="FONT-WEIGHT: normal"><font id="TAB2" style="LETTER-SPACING: 9pt">&#160;&#160;&#160;</font>&#160;&#160;&#160; Avon.</font></font></font><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Under a license agreement with Avon, dated June&#160;26, 2003, we have an exclusive worldwide license to manufacture and sell skin care products containing an ascorbic acid component directly to physicians and medical spas.&#160;&#160;Under the terms of the agreement, we also have a non-exclusive license to manufacture and sell such products directly to drug stores outside of the United States.&#160;&#160;We paid Avon a non-refundable license issue fee.&#160;&#160;Additionally, we pay a non-refundable annual renewal fee.&#160;&#160;The original term of the agreement expired in 2006 and we have continued to annually renew the agreement each year since that time.&#160;&#160;Our annual option to renew the agreement survives until the last of the licensed patents expires on September&#160;10, 2018.&#160;&#160;Each party, at its option, may terminate the agreement upon prior written notice in the case of default in the performance of any obligation under the agreement by the other party and failure to take action to cure such a default within a specified period.&#160;&#160;If we become bankrupt or insolvent, or file&#160;a petition for bankruptcy, or if our business is placed in the hands of a receiver, assignee or trustee from which we cannot extract ourselves within 120&#160;days, or if we are liquidated or substantially all of our assets or shares are sold, exchanged or transferred, or in the event of a merger or consolidation to which we are a party and to which Avon reasonably objects, the agreement shall immediately terminate without notice.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We had a right of first refusal for the exclusive license of any and all of JR&#8217;s inventions that he introduced to us related to skin healthcare that were developed or reduced to practice by JR during the term of the agreement, subject to certain exceptions.&#160;&#160;In the event that we exercised this right and obtained such an exclusive license, we agreed to pay a tiered royalty to JR.&#160;&#160;We are entitled, however, to credit against such royalty payments a portion of the expenses we have incurred to develop and commercialize any product subject to the exclusive license.&#160;&#160;We paid JR an aggregate of approximately $0.4 million, $0.4 million and $0.3 million in royalty fees under the agreement for the years ended December 31, 2011, 2010 and 2009, respectively.&#160;&#160;To the extent that we sublicense any of our rights under an exclusive license in exchange for only a license fee, we have agreed to pay JR a portion of any such license fee that we receive, subject to an annual cap and to our ability to credit against any amounts due to JR a portion of the research and development expenses we incurred in connection with the sublicense.&#160;&#160;Any such sublicense would be subject to JR&#8217;s prior approval, which approval may not be unreasonably withheld.&#160;&#160;We have negotiated a separate royalty arrangement for sales of our bi-mineral complex with Rohto.&#160;&#160;Pursuant to our arrangement with Rohto, in December 2008, we amended the JR&#160;Agreement to modify the royalty rates paid to JR based on Rohto's sales of products containing the bi-mineral technology.&#160;</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We are currently in discussions with JR on a variety of matters.&#160;&#160;We have been advised by JR that it believes that certain of our products, including the ELASTIderm line of products, and CLENZIderm and Rosaclear, are covered by both issued and pending patents which JR contends are owned by it and which it believes were licensed to us under the JR Agreement.&#160;&#160;JR contends that such license and our right to continue to sell such products terminated when the JR Agreement terminated.&#160;&#160;We disagree with JR&#8217;s position on this issue and are seeking to resolve this and other issues in our ongoing negotiations with JR.&#160;Should we fail to reach agreement with respect to these current discussions, we could end up in litigation with JR regarding the ownership rights to these technologies, and our business, results of operations and financial condition could be adversely affected.&#160;&#160;See &#8220;Risk Factors &#8211; Risks Related to Intellectual Property - <font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline">If we are involved in intellectual property claims and litigation, the proceedings may divert our resources and subject us to significant liability for damages, substantial litigation expense and the loss of our proprietary rights </font>and - <font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline">We and our manufacturers and suppliers license certain technologies and patents from third parties.&#160;&#160;If these licenses are breached, terminated or disputed, our ability to commercialize products dependent on these technologies and patents may be compromised&#8221; </font>in Part I, Item 1A of this Report<font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline">.</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">On December 4, 2008, we entered into an amendment (the &#8220;Rohto Amendment&#8221;) to the original agreement with Rohto.&#160;&#160;The Rohto Amendment extends the term of agreement to December 4, 2017 and&#160;permits extension of&#160;the Territory (as defined in the agreement) to areas outside Japan, subject to separate written agreement(s).&#160;&#160;The Channel (as defined in the agreement) has been expanded to include department stores if certain conditions are met.&#160;&#160;To date, these conditions have not been met.&#160;&#160;Rohto and Obagi have also agreed to work together to up-brand the Obagi products sold in the various channels and work cooperatively on messaging, branding and product imaging.&#160;&#160;Under the Rohto Amendment, Obagi has also agreed to provide an exclusive royalty-bearing license to sell and/or manufacture certain products developed by Obagi, Rohto or jointly developed by Obagi and Rohto.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Our products also compete with current and future medical devices, such as lasers, which are or will be positioned for a variety of skin enhancements such as facial rejuvenation, dermal thickening, acne and other uses.&#160;&#160;Competitors in this market include Syneron Medical&#160;Ltd., CoolTouch Corporation, Cutera, Inc., Cynosure,&#160;Inc., Lumenis&#160;Ltd., Reliant Technologies,&#160;Inc. and Solta Medical,&#160;Inc.&#160;&#160;However, we believe, when used as a pre/post treatment, our Obagi Systems are complementary to many of these procedures.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Government Regulation</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Federal, state and local governmental authorities in the United States and other countries regulate, among other things, the testing, production, distribution, advertising promotion and sale of prescription and OTC drugs and cosmetics.&#160;&#160;In the United States, the FDA, acting under the Food Drug and Cosmetic Act (&#8220;FDCA&#8221;),&#160;and other&#160;federal statutes (including the Public Health Service Act, Administrative Procedure Act, Federal Trade Commission Act, Fair Packaging and Labeling Act, Lanham Act and Homeland Security Act) and&#160;agencies implementing regulations, regulate our&#160;products primarily on the basis of their intended use, as determined by the labeling claims or other representations made for the product.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">FDA regulation of cosmetics</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The FDCA defines cosmetics as products and their components intended to be rubbed, poured, sprinkled, or sprayed on, introduced into, or otherwise applied to the human body or any part thereof for cleansing, beautifying, promoting attractiveness, or altering the appearance.&#160;&#160;Cosmetic products are not subject to FDA pre-market approval authority, although the FDA can take enforcement action under the Code of Federal Regulations (&#8220;CFR&#8221;) for marketed cosmetic products that are adulterated or misbranded, including violations of product safety requirements, use and quantity of ingredients, labeling and promotion and methods of manufacture.&#160;&#160;Additionally, the FDA monitors compliance of cosmetic products through random inspections of cosmetic company websites, importers, manufacturers and distributors.&#160;&#160;The labeling of cosmetic products is subject to the requirements of the FDCA, the Fair Packaging and Labeling Act and other FDA regulations.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&#160;</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We believe that many of the products in the Obagi Nu-Derm, Condition &amp; Enhance, Obagi-C Rx, Professional-C, ELASTIderm, CLENZIderm M.D. and Obagi Rosaclear Systems and other product lines, as labeled and intended for use, fall within the FDA definition of cosmetics and therefore do not require pre-market review and approval.&#160;&#160;Cosmetics may be sold both OTC and through a physician&#8217;s office, subject to state laws governing the commercial practices of physicians.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">FDA regulation of drug products</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The FDCA defines drugs as products intended to cure, mitigate, treat or prevent a disease or to affect the structure or any function of the human body.&#160;&#160;Drug products are subject to more comprehensive safety and efficacy requirements of the FDCA and its implementing regulations.&#160;&#160;In general, products falling within the FDCA&#8217;s definition of &#8220;new drugs&#8221; require pre-marketing review and approval by the FDA.&#160;&#160;Products falling within the FDCA&#8217;s definition of &#8220;drugs&#8221; that are not &#8220;new drugs&#8221; because they are generally recognized as &#8220;safe and effective&#8221; for the indication for which they are being marketed and have been used to a material extent and for a material time under those conditions generally do not require pre-market review and approval from the FDA.&#160;&#160;In addition, certain&#160;other drugs that have been in existence for a specified period of time&#160;are not currently&#160;subject to&#160;FDA pre-market review and approval.&#160;&#160;The official legal status of many of these drug products has often not been determined or finalized. Others are marketed under the FDA's regulatory discretion. The FDA has established enforcement priorities for determining when the agency will take enforcement action against marketed unapproved drugs.&#160;&#160;This enforcement policy is set forth in FDA Compliance Policy Guide (&#8220;CPG&#8221;) entitled &#8220;Marketed New Drugs Without Approved New Drug Applications.&#8221; The CPG, however, does not confer any legal authority to market an unapproved drug.&#160;&#160;The FDA has reserved the right to take enforcement action (e.g. seizure, injunction or criminal prosecution) against any marketed unapproved drug at any time.&#160;&#160;Additionally, <font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">marketed unapproved drugs are subject to compliance with FDA regulations concerning manufacture, labeling, distribution, and recordkeeping for drug products.<a name="eolPage16"><!--EFPlaceholder--></a></font> </font>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><br>
</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Brief History of the Development of the FDCA</font></font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><br>
</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The original federal Pure Food and Drug Act was adopted in 1906 and prohibited the sale of adulterated or misbranded drugs, but did not require that drugs be approved by the FDA prior to marketing.&#160;&#160;In 1938, Congress enacted the FDCA, which required that all &#8220;new drugs&#8221; be approved for safety through a New Drug Application (&#8220;NDA&#8221;).&#160;&#160;Drugs that were on the market prior to the enactment of the FDCA were exempt from &#8220;new drug&#8221; status under a grandfather clause, and did not require an NDA.&#160;&#160;If a new drug was approved by the FDA between 1938 and </font></font></div>
</div>

<div align="left">&#160;</div>

<div align="left">
<div id="PGBRK" style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; WIDTH: 100%; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">
<div id="FTR">
<div id="GLFTR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</div>

<div id="PN" style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; WIDTH: 100%">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">16</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%">
<hr style="COLOR: black" noshade size="2">
</div>
</div>

<div id="HDR">
<div id="GLHDR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="right"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">1962, the FDA generally allowed identical, related or similar (&#8220;IRS&#8221;) drugs to be marketed without independent approval on the grounds that the active&#160;ingredient(s) was generally recognized as safe.&#160;&#160;In 1962, Congress amended the FDCA to require that all &#8220;new drugs&#8221; be demonstrated to be effective as well as safe to obtain FDA approval.&#160;&#160;However, under a grandfather clause in the 1962 amendment, a drug was exempt from the effectiveness requirement if, before the amendment was enacted, it was: (i) used or sold commercially in the United States; (ii) not considered a &#8220;new drug;&#8221; and (iii) not covered by an effective application.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The Drug Efficacy Study Implementation (&#8220;DESI&#8221;) was a program begun by FDA in 1962 after the amendments to the FDCA were adopted.&#160;&#160;The DESI program was intended to classify all pre-1962 drugs that were already on the market and approved based on safety only as either effective, ineffective, or needing further study.&#160;&#160;The DESI program evaluated over 3,000 separate products and over 16,000 therapeutic claims.&#160;&#160;By 1984, final action had been completed on 3,443 products; of these, 2,225 were found to be effective, 1,051 were found not effective, and 167 were pending.&#160;&#160;The DESI program remains uncompleted because the FDA turned its regulatory priorities to more pressing regulatory matters, (the OTC Drug Review (the &#8220;OTC Review&#8221;) in the 1970's,&#160;the generic drug scandal in the late 1980's,&#160;the so-called drug lag in the 1990's, and the backlog in applications for generic drugs since the turn of the century with the need for increased inspections for raw material suppliers and applicants). The interactions of these mixed programs and priorities have created gray legal areas for drug products that have been marketed for decades in accordance with the FDA's CPG.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Drugs that did not have pre-1962 approvals or that were not IRS to drugs with pre-1962 approvals were not subject to DESI.&#160;&#160;Some of these products are not formally exempt from the FDA pre-marketing &#8220;new drug&#8221; approval today, but are being marketed and sold based on being grandfathered or generally recognized as safe and effective subject to the enforcement priorities set forth&#160;in the CPG unless the FDA determines that a NDA must be filed or otherwise concludes that such product is not a new drug.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">FDA regulation of &#8220;new drug&#8221; products</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Today, the steps required before a &#8220;new drug&#8221; may be marketed in the United States include: (i)&#160;pre-clinical laboratory and animal testing; (ii)&#160;submission to the FDA of an Investigational New Drug (&#8220;IND&#8221;), application, which must become effective before clinical trials may commence; (iii)&#160;adequate and well controlled clinical trials to establish the safety and efficacy of the drug; (iv)&#160;submission to the FDA of a NDA; and (v)&#160;FDA approval of the NDA prior to any commercial sale or shipment of the drug. An ANDA is required to be submitted and approved when the drug product intended for commercialization is bioequivalent to an already approved NDA product; an ANDA application does not need to repeat the clinical trials that were required for approval of the NDA, or reference listed drug.&#160;&#160;In addition to obtaining FDA approval for each product, each domestic drug-manufacturing establishment must be registered with the FDA.&#160;&#160;Drug product manufacturing establishments located in California also must be licensed by the State of California in compliance with separate regulatory requirements.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Pre-clinical testing is generally conducted on laboratory animals to evaluate the potential safety and the efficacy of a drug.&#160;&#160;The results of these studies are submitted to the FDA as a part of an IND, which must be approved before clinical trials in humans can begin.&#160;&#160;Typically, clinical evaluation involves a time consuming and costly three-phase process.&#160;&#160;In Phase&#160;I, clinical trials are conducted with a small number of subjects to determine the early safety profile, the pattern of drug distribution and metabolism.&#160;&#160;In Phase&#160;II, clinical trials are conducted with groups of patients afflicted with a specific disease to determine preliminary efficacy, optimal dosages and expanded evidence of safety.&#160;&#160;In Phase&#160;III, large-scale, multi-center, comparative trials are conducted with patients afflicted with a target disease to provide sufficient data to demonstrate the efficacy and safety required by the FDA.&#160;&#160;The FDA closely monitors the progress of each of the three phases of clinical trials and may, at its discretion, re-evaluate, alter, suspend or terminate the testing based upon the data that have been accumulated to that point and its assessment of the risk/benefit ratio to the patient.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We in-license&#160;three ANDA products, tretinoin, Refissa&#160;and metronidazole, all prescription drug product offerings.&#160;&#160;Each&#160;supplier holds FDA approval of ANDAs for&#160;its respective&#160;products.</font></div>

<div align="left">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&#160;</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">FDA Enforcement Discretion for Marketed Unapproved Drug Products</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Products falling within the FDCA&#8217;s definition of &#8220;drugs&#8221; that are not &#8220;new drugs&#8221; because they are generally recognized as &#8220;safe and effective&#8221; for the indication for which they are being marketed or fall within the 1938 or 1962 grandfather clauses are not required to obtain&#160;pre-market review and approval from the FDA.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We market a number of products containing 4% hydroquinone (the &#8220;HQ Products&#8221;) that we believe are not &#8220;new drug&#8221; products subject to FDA pre-market approval and that are&#160;marketed subject to the enforcement priorities in the CPG.&#160;&#160;The Obagi Nu-Derm Clear, Blender and Sunfader products and the Obagi-C Rx C-Clarifying Serum, C-Night </font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">&#160;</div>
</div>

<div align="left">
<div id="PGBRK" style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; WIDTH: 100%; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">
<div id="FTR">
<div id="GLFTR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>

<div align="left"><br>
<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Therapy Cream and ELASTIderm D&#233;colletage Skin Lightening Complex products contain the active ingredient hydroquinone at a 4% concentration and are marketed as prescription drugs.&#160;&#160;These HQ Products must be administered under the supervision of a physician but are not currently subject to prior FDA approval when formulated and labeled in accordance with guidelines for prescriber information under direction of a physician because we believe they do not fall within the statutory definition of a &#8220;new drug.<a name="eolPage17"><!--EFPlaceholder--></a>&#8221;</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Hydroquinone, as a skin bleaching agent has been subject to FDA regulation as an OTC drug in certain concentrations since the initiation of the OTC Review in the early 1970's.&#160;&#160;The OTC Review was created to replicate the DESI Review by evaluating the safety and effectiveness of the data available for the active ingredients (drugs) in the hundreds of thousands of OTC drug products that were on the market.&#160;&#160;Drugs that are subject to the OTC Review are and have been in a regulatory safe harbor for the uses covered by that multi-step process pending completion of the monograph applicable to the intended use under the OTC Review and the CPG.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">To date, the FDA has not required NDA or other approval for the continued marketing of hydroquinone.&#160;&#160;In August 2006, the FDA issued a proposed rule that stated that OTC skin bleaching products containing hydroquinone and currently marketed outside the physician channel at 2% concentrations or less, were not generally recognized as safe and effective, were misbranded, and are new drugs within the meaning of the FDCA.&#160;&#160;The FDA proposed that because of the carcinogenic and ochronosis potential of hydroquinone, its use in skin bleaching drug products should be restricted to prescription use only, and users of such products should be closely monitored under medical supervision.&#160;&#160;The FDA also withdrew a tentative proposed monograph that concluded that hydroquinone products with concentrations of 2% or less were generally recognized as safe and effective and stated its intent to require NDA approval for continued marketing of prescription hydroquinone products at the time of publication of the final rule.&#160;&#160;In the proposed rule, the FDA recommended that additional studies be conducted to determine if there is a risk to humans from the use of hydroquinone.&#160;&#160;The FDA nominated hydroquinone for further study by the National Toxicology Program (the &#8220;NTP&#8221;), and in December 2009 the NTP Board of Scientific Counselors approved the nomination.&#160;&#160;As a result, the following three NTP studies will be conducted:</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block" align="left"><br>
</div>
